mods.name: Currency Mod
mods.description: A mod that adds a currency system, player shops, and economy features to Minecraft

releases.notes:
A comprehensive economy mod for Minecraft Fabric servers featuring virtual currency, job progression, land ownership, player shops, and subscription services. Includes modern GUI interfaces, admin management tools, automatic tax collection, and robust data storage. Perfect for servers seeking a professional economy system with player trading, land management, and progression mechanics.

Ready Mod File: `rivers_economy-1.0.0.jar`

readmeSummary: A comprehensive Minecraft Fabric mod that adds a server-based economy system with player shops, auctions, jobs, property ownership, and a marketplace.
